tier1.headline: Your Data Shared Commercially
tier1.quote: We may disclose User Information to other unaffiliated third parties, specifically with (i) our data partners , so that we can connect you with relevant content by allowing our advertisers to target specific audience segments, and (ii) our programmatic demand and supply partners , so that we can serve you with tailored advertisements.

tier1.headline: Your Interactions Train Our AI
tier1.quote: Product Improvement : To train, fine-tune, and improve the accuracy of our AI models and algorithms.

tier2.headline: Your Data Retained for Analysis
tier2.quote: We retain deidentified or aggregated data, which cannot identify an individual or device and is used for purposes of reporting and analysis, for as long as commercially necessary.

tier2.headline: Your Precise Location Collected
tier2.quote: Taboola News : We collect in-app User behaviors (e.g. online status, browsing activity, and clicks) and implicit non-precise device location inferred from search queries (when enabled by the User) and SIM cards or IP addresses.

tier2.headline: Your Behavior Leads To Profiles
tier2.quote: Advertising : We may use insights from your interactions to serve relevant advertisements and create personalized interest profiles.

tier2.headline: Your Data Used For Targeted Ads
tier2.quote: Through our Services, including our Services on Customer websites, we may provide advertisements to you based on your recent browsing behavior across different Customer websites, browsers, or devices.

tier2.headline: Your Data Leaves Your Country
tier2.quote: We may transfer your Information outside the country in which it is collected, including to a country that may not offer the same level of protection for Information as the country in which you reside.
